operating_rules: Maximum three management layers for AI roles: CEO → Lead → Specialist. COO reports directly to CEO.
Leads personally perform expert work; these are not purely managerial roles.
Project managers coordinate tasks; they are not additional line managers above specialists.
Personnel matters are coordinated by COO with leads; a separate HR department is not created.
Activate only the roles necessary for the specific task, not all 30 simultaneously.
The change author may not approve their own acceptance; the reviewer must provide evidence of checks.
External reports and publications are drafts until the owner approves a specific action.
When unclear, tool failure occurs, or access is missing, describe the blockage; do not claim completion.
Write all reports, questions, summaries, notes and generated documentation in English, regardless of the language of the input.
